## Source discovery and admission audits

Five fresh Chinese web-fiction candidates were discovered for the 2026-08-17 source program: Qidian / 起点中文网, JJWXC / 晋江文学城, Zongheng / 纵横中文网, Fanqie / 番茄小说, and Changpei / 长佩文学.

- **Qidian — pass link-only.** The official platform exposes current reader discovery routes. Its current user/service agreements reserve platform and creator content and do not grant blanket reuse rights. Admission is therefore limited to the official landing URL plus WebNR-authored discovery metadata.
- **JJWXC — pass link-only.** The official public work-library route is a useful reader discovery surface. Current user and authorization statements reserve site and creator rights and do not justify copying the catalog, works, paid chapters, comments, or account data. Admission is navigation-only.
- **Zongheng — pass link-only.** The official platform exposes categories, rankings, library, and completion-oriented discovery. Its current legal notice restricts copying, reposting, modification, distribution, and related reuse without permission. Admission is navigation-only.
- **Fanqie — deferred.** Current official discovery and agreement surfaces were identified, but richer source-specific rights, robots, interface, pagination, cadence, update/deletion, and fixture evidence has not yet been reduced to a reproducible admission contract. No entry was integrated.
- **Changpei — deferred.** A current official reader surface was identified, but a complete source-specific rights/access, robots, interface, request-cadence, and fixture audit remains necessary before admission. No entry was integrated.

Pull request #95 added `Chinese Web-Fiction Platforms Starter` with the three passing official destinations. It stores only official landing URLs, WebNR-authored descriptions, labels, and provenance boundaries. It performs no runtime API, HTML, feed, chapter, account, payment, VIP, or catalog polling and does not bypass login, payment, age gates, DRM, captchas, robots, or access controls. Direct robots-file retrieval was not treated as permission for this zero-request link-only tier; any richer adapter remains gated on a separate reproducible source-specific audit.

Rotating maintained-source health checks revisited Aozora Bunko, Project Madurai, and Wolne Lektury. Their representative official discovery surfaces and the existing WebNR link/reuse boundaries remain consistent with current public evidence; no maintained source required repair, downgrade, or removal.
